sourceSentences: Orianna cannot use Command: Protect while The Ball is in transit with Command: Attack but she may buffer Command: Dissonance and Command: Shockwave to cast once it has reached the location.
The Ball will drop to the ground upon colliding with W [Yasuo] but not with E [Braum].
The Ball snaps back to Orianna upon being intercepted by projectile-blocking effects.
The Ball will join Command: Protect's target ally in stealth if they are affected by it when Orianna targets them.
Orianna gains Command: Protect's bonus resistances whenever The Ball is attached to her (even if she didn't self-cast).
Additionally, The Ball attaches to Orianna if she is near it, and snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a 0.75-second cooldown on Command: Shockwave.
Command: Shockwave will cast from wherever the unit the The Ball is attached to is at the end of the cast time, even if the unit exceeds max tether range.
Orianna's basic attacks generate a stack of Clockwork Winding for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.
The Ball does not grant sight while in flight, but the sound effect of striking an enemy is audible through the Fog of War.
Your basic combo: attack, Q behind the enemy's back, then W. After that, you can return the bullet through the enemy with E and continue the attack.
In a teamfight, use Q, W, and your ultimate for massive damage, then return the orb to yourself or an ally via E. To initiate, throw E at a charging ally.
When he is in the center of the enemy team, press ult, then Q and continue attacking.
So you do a classic combo and then you bring the ball back to you, trying to make it pass through as many enemies as possible.
Then you have QRW from level 6. It's the classic ultimate combo. You start with your R to group the targets and then you put the W on everyone.
And finally, you have the R flasher with W. This will allow you to surprise your opponent. It's very useful if the guy has a dash. So it's very simple, the ball is on you, you R and you flash
when the orb is on you or one of your allies, it will give you bonus armor and MR even if the active shield has disappeared.
You can make it invisible if your orb is hidden, and therefore the ultimate will also be hidden.
Continue auto-attacking as you exit the indicator to instantly have the ball on you before comboing
as long as the R animation starts when the ball is considered in the indicator, your shock wave will be launched and it will end where the ball is at the end of the animation
